subject: general
question: Which of the following information is necessary to construct a rectangle?

options.text: Only the length of one side
Only the length of the diagonal
Length of one side and the area of the rectangle

solution:
__**Explanation:**__

To construct a rectangle, it is essential to know the length of two adjacent sides. This is because:

 
• A rectangle has two pairs of opposite sides that are equal in length. Knowing the lengths of two adjacent sides allows you to determine the dimensions of the entire rectangle.
 
• For example, if the length (L) and width (W) of a rectangle are provided, you can construct the rectangle by drawing two pairs of parallel lines of the given lengths and ensuring that all angles are right angles.
 
• The relationship between the sides ensures that the unique shape of the rectangle is maintained without ambiguity.
